estimates.assumptions: Medium onion is typically 110g when finely diced; calorie density matches supplied known value for raw onion.
1 tsp cumin seeds weighs ~2g; calorie density matches supplied known value.
1 tsp harissa spice/powder weighs ~2.7g (similar to other ground spices); calories estimated from typical harissa blend (chili-based, lower than pure chili powder).
